exercicio.statement:
Sean's baseball team played against Barry's team. The two teams were tied after nine innings, so the game went into extra innings. Sean's team won the game in the tenth inning. Usually a game only lasts nine innings, but since they played a tenth, Sean and Barry's game lasted 10/9 as long as a normal game. Show 10/9 on the number line.
What is the fraction in the problem?

steps.instruction: Build the fraction that compares the 10 innings played with a normal 9-inning game.
Enter the numerator in the top fraction box.
Enter the denominator in the bottom fraction box.
Type the numerator 10 into field f1.
Type the denominator 9 into field f2.
Use the fraction model to show that the game lasted more than one normal game.
Convert 10/9 and enter the mixed number in the displayed fields.
Estimate where 10/9 belongs on the number line from 0 to 2.
Place the point at 10/9 on the number line.
After checking the fraction and point, complete the problem with Done.
